review: Independent read-only source and gold review by answerability_review, plus root review. 24 labels, 7 files, 2 licenses, 41 passage ranges checked before inference. H03 support quote expanded to include its DON'T heading before freeze; inputs and gold actions unchanged.
selection: 24 authored questions over manually selected intact source excerpts and ablations, across six new families. No candidate model consulted while authoring. Not production queries, retrieval outputs, random sampling or pretraining isolation.
primary: Trial 1, normal passage/fact/candidate order; all 24 cases. Report whole set and 22 unresolved cases separately.
robustness: Two trials, normal/reversed passage/fact/candidate ordering together. Correlated descriptive observations, not additional independent examples.
code: Same common_gate as teaching. One authoritative exact fact allow and one missing-fact defer; no keyword substitute for retrieval.
decision: Same 710-byte task instructions/categories, Qwen constrained JSON thinking off; Kev native selected argmax. No threshold tuning.
timing: Preparation plus HTTP/validation; startup and one warmup per model separate. Same pinned runtime/models as teaching, prefix caching configured enabled in both; observed reuse must be audited. No cold/matched-cache interpretation.
interpretation: Compare unsupported allows and supported deferrals before timing. A quality tradeoff is not superiority without a caller error budget; small cache-confounded timing differences alone do not justify a model switch. Actual pipeline benefit remains a separate test.
failure_policy: Keep malformed/transport/unattempted cases in denominators; operational defer does not count as correct semantic judgement. No retries or prompt changes after outputs.
